title: ‘Pang-intriga’: Palace dismisses Erice’s ‘presidential pork barrel’ tag
summary: Malacañang on Wednesday pushed back at Caloocan City Representative Edgar Erice for calling the Local Government Support Fund (LGSF) a “presidential pork barrel”, dismissing it as an “intrigue”.
